== Dated primary-rulebook discussion ==
The 1998 [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary]], PDF page 25, says that the Effect remains regardless of which side controls the starship until the starship leaves table, and describes escape when no Dark characters are present. The final Decipher [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], cover updated 29 January 2002, PDF page 11, already describes release on tractor-beam cancellation. The documentary article now distinguishes those dated explanatory sources. Its prior unqualified Scomp/Light.json ruling bullets have been replaced with these primary-source statements; this does not transfer the modern Advanced Rulebook’s disposition rules into the 1998 state, assign a new ID or change any printed game words. The exact first appearance of every later rule nuance remains unestablished.
